facts.text: I need to carefully distribute tokens to stakeholders based on impact, ecosystem development, and participation incentives instead of investor funding.
I want a rewards system designed to redistribute tokens/wealth and drive participation as an incentive.
I am referencing a rewards system called dfresh earth rewards (FER) 4.2.3.5 Data Comms.
The Data Comms Platform collects, manages, and analyses data from the Fresh Earth Index.
The Data Comms Platform analyses impact delivered, growth, milestones, and platform participation data from the ecosystem.
The Data Comms Platform translates analysed data into targeted communications to the Fresh Earth community.
The targeted communications are intended to influence, validate, and reward environmental and health behaviour and impacts.
Communications are measured and feed back into the data to continually improve algorithms and communications strategies.
Users can showcase their impact by creating dashboards and publishing them on their profiles or projects.
Transactions within the platform are transparent so any user can understand the breakdown of what percentage each person in the process is making, including the Platform.
The transparent ledger keeps money within the ecosystem and encourages sharing of wealth between stakeholders.
The transparent ledger is intended to optimise costs through participation and “Data Comms” nudging.
I asked to list, for each division of a tech company, the documents required to commercialise the system globally.
I asked to take into consideration the categories of technology development, marketing and communications, and investment documentation.
I asked whether other categories are important as well.
I asked to combine two lists into a final list.
I asked to use a different numbering style so I can copy and print the list in a good format.
I asked to adopt the same numbering style with all documents we develop.
